prior_production_model.description: v1: 6-feature GBM (career_avg, platoon_delta, pitcher_oba_against, park_factor, is_home, batting_order), trained/validated with a within-2025-season date split only.

metadata.note: random_forest scored marginally better on this same 2026 holdout (log_loss 0.6463 vs this gbm's 0.6468) but was rejected: sklearn's RandomForestClassifier has no monotonic-constraint mechanism, and direct point-checks showed it predicting a .230 career hitter below a .200 one at otherwise-default features -- the same backwards-prediction pathology monotonic_cst was introduced to fix in the original 6-feature model. This gbm has monotonic_cst applied (see scripts/train_ml_model.py MONOTONIC_CST) and was verified by point-checks across every constrained feature before shipping.
